> **Common Commands**
>
> * Add route: `sudo ip route add 10.0.0.0/24 via 192.168.1.1`
> * List rules: `ip rule show`
> * Enable forwarding:
>
>   ```bash
>   sudo sysctl -w net.ipv4.ip_forward=1
>   # persist in /etc/sysctl.conf
>   ```
